description: This header file declares internal function prototypes for managing an HTTP Webc Session object within the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes functions related to session state management, connection handling, request processing, and internal property management.

methods.name: HttpWcsoGetPeerName
methods.description: Retrieves the peer name associated with the HTTP Webc Session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoSetPeerName
methods.description: Sets the peer name for the HTTP Webc Session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the property object associated with the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets the property object for the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoResetProperty
methods.description: Resets the session property to default.

methods.name: HttpWcsoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the session object.

methods.name: HttpWcsoReturn
methods.description: Returns the session object, likely to a pool or manager.

methods.name: HttpWcsoMatchServer
methods.description: Checks if the server matches given name, port, and flags.

methods.name: HttpWcsoIsReadyToRequest
methods.description: Determines if the session is ready to process a request.

methods.name: HttpWcsoAcquireAccess
methods.description: Acquire exclusive access to the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoGetEndWcto
methods.description: Retrieves the end WCT object associated with the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoAddNewWcto
methods.description: Adds a new WCT object to the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoDelAllWctos
methods.description: Deletes all WCT objects associated with the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoConnect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the session.

methods.name: HttpWcsoRequest
methods.description: Processes a request with specified method, URI, and context.

methods.name: HttpWcsoConnectPeer
methods.description: Initiates connection to specified IP address.

methods.name: HttpWcsoSctowoQuery
methods.description: Performs query in SCTOWO (Stream Control Transport Over WebSocket) context.
